definition: Google Cloud Search (formerly known as Google Springboard) is an enterprise search tool integrated with Google Workspace.
details: It allows users to search for content in Google apps including Gmail, Google Docs, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Contacts, and Google Sites. It also provides “actionable information & recommendations” to users based on machine learning. In February 2017, Google Springboard was renamed Google Cloud Search.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Google Cloud Search — a small key that opens a big door.
